name: dotascope
description: Installable Dota 2 meta intelligence cockpit powered by the OpenDota public API.
author: DotaScope

scripts.windows:build: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
